ios.desc:
Name chord progressions, tune notes that are off, sing chords and catch sharp notes in four bite-sized ear-training games. Fresh daily challenges, the same puzzles for everyone.

No ads. No required login. Download and play.

Build a daily streak, climb the weekly leaderboard, and watch your accuracy improve week over week.


PROG ROCK

Hear a chord progression on marimba, then name it. A Daily Challenge brings five fresh rounds a day, plus unlimited Practice. Easy is I-IV-V multiple choice, Medium strays from the I chord, and Hard has you enter every chord you hear. Practice in any of the seven modes, from major and minor to Dorian, Mixolydian, Lydian, Phrygian and Locrian, and Center Your Ear plays the cadence that fits whichever one you pick.


TUNE-A-FISH (NEW)

One note is out of tune. Drag its fish until it sounds right. Easy is a single note, Medium is an interval, and Hard is a full chord with one note off by a quarter tone or a half step. Hear the original, hear yours, then check your tuning. Five fish a day in the Daily Challenge, plus Practice in sets of ten.


STRIKE A CHORD

Sing chords note by note. Arrows show whether to go higher or lower, and there are no lives to lose.

PRACTICE: Every note is played for you first. Each set ends with your accuracy and the notes you sang cleanly, and your longest run of clean chords ranks on the leaderboard.

DAILY CHALLENGE: Five chords a day, the same for everyone worldwide.


PITCHIN' IMPOSSIBLE

Listen to two notes. Is the second one sharp or flat?

EASY: 50 cents apart. Perfect for building pitch awareness.
MEDIUM: 25 cents apart, for developing ears.
HARD: 10 cents apart. Can you hear the subtlest shifts?

Sets of ten calls, keep going as long as you like, and your streak of correct calls ranks on the leaderboards.


STREAKS AND LEADERBOARDS

• Daily streaks for all three daily challenges, with a play-history grid on the home screen
• A This Week ladder across every game, plus Today and All-Time boards in each
• Progress charts for your accuracy and scores over time
• Warm marimba samples across every game


MUSIC MINI GAMES PRO: A COACH FOR YOUR EAR

For musicians who want to actually get better. Pro finds your weak spots and names the chord that keeps catching you out, lets you practice exactly what you miss, shows a full year of your progress by difficulty, and unlocks every chord in Strike a Chord and all seven modes in Prog Rock. It also includes unlimited renames and a Pro badge on the boards.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Music Mini Games - an iOS app

quotes.text:
I built an iOS App with claude code. I really don't know any swift myself. The app is a couple of small musical games (it's called music mini games). I've got _very few_ users.

What surprised me most is that, now more ever, distribution really is king. An app I released in the same space !11 years ago! gets more daily downloads. I expect these trends to accelerate with the amount of software being shipped with AI.

"If you build it, they will come" has never been less true.

I do really believe in product led marketing, though. I'm not yet fully convinced my app is good enough to get tons of word of mouth referrals. Hopefully one day.

If you're still here, here's the app:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/music-mini-games/id6752395649

quotes.text:
I've just released an iOS app that contains a few simple music games. I hope to add more in the future, and to improve the existing games. Over the long run I hope I'm able to build experiences that are both fun and help you become a better musician. It's rough around the edges, and very early, but feedback and feature requests are still welcome. On the marketing page I have an email list and a way to contact me, so I'd love thoughts.

No login, no subscription, no network required, no analytics, 5 MB binary

iOS link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/music-mini-games/id6752395649?platform=iphone

marketing page: https://musicminigames.com/
